speaker: narrator
text: Touch the map beside a town and raise your factory.

speaker: narrator
text: The factory is the hub. Every road and rail comes home to it.

speaker: narrator
text: Now a depot. Set it beside a mill, a mine, or a forest.

speaker: narrator
text: No depot yet. Open Depot, then mark the ground by an industry.

speaker: narrator
text: Match three gems. Your score sets how much this depot yields.

speaker: narrator
text: Clear what you can. A high score pays on every tick.

speaker: narrator
text: Pick Dirt Road. Drag from the depot back to your factory.

speaker: narrator
text: Nothing ticks until the road joins depot and factory.

speaker: narrator
text: You are producing. Stars come from depots, roads, and the city.

speaker: narrator
text: When the purse allows, raise the city. Every depot ticks faster.

speaker: narrator
text: Hear that? The first cargo has ticked into the purse.

speaker: narrator
text: Keep the road open. Every tick is wages on the ledger.

speaker: narrator
text: Rail hauls faster than a road. Lay track from industry to plant.

speaker: narrator
text: Keep the run straight. A train will not take a sharp corner.

speaker: narrator
text: Raise a platform at each end. That is where the train stops.

speaker: narrator
text: One platform at the industry, one at the factory. Then she runs.

speaker: narrator
text: This island is yours. Every industry on it is cargo waiting for a road.

speaker: narrator
text: Roll the wheel to zoom, and the target key in the menu brings you home.

speaker: narrator
text: Along the top: your money and materials, the race, the menu, and the radio.

speaker: narrator
text: R turns the building before you set it down. Right-click puts the tool away.

speaker: narrator
text: One Depot per industry, and the first to connect keeps it.

speaker: narrator
text: Finish keeps the score you have. The results card shows what the Depot now ticks.

speaker: narrator
text: Dirt Road is free. Street, Road and Highway haul faster and cost money.

speaker: narrator
text: A Highway joins your roads through a Ramp. A Road across it becomes an overpass.

speaker: narrator
text: Bridges cross the water and slopes climb the hills. Nothing builds through a steep face.

speaker: narrator
text: One train runs a network, and it hauls on its own once both platforms stand.

speaker: narrator
text: The Plant card holds Retune. Another session raises a Depot's yield.

speaker: narrator
text: A played session opens the next rung of the depot tree, and new Depot types with it.

speaker: narrator
text: Click a Depot on the map to upgrade it. Its yield cap doubles at every level.

speaker: narrator
text: The drawer along the bottom holds Bank, Market, Black Market, Feed and Quests.

speaker: narrator
text: The Bank exchanges one cargo for another, once the depot tree has opened the rung.

speaker: narrator
text: The Market is where you sell materials for money. Prices move, so sell high.

speaker: narrator
text: Gold buys Black Market work: a blockade on an industry, or a protest on a public road.

speaker: narrator
text: The Feed logs everything that happened, yours and your rival's.

speaker: narrator
text: Quests are optional. Each one suggests a job and pays when it is done.

speaker: narrator
text: Your rival runs the same loop you do. Watch its roads grow across the map.

speaker: narrator
text: Click an industry with Select to Challenge it. It costs Gold and opens a battle.

speaker: narrator
text: A battle is a match-3 duel on one board. Every gem you match hits your rival.

speaker: narrator
text: Win a contested site and you hold it. Holds pay stars, up to a cap.

speaker: narrator
text: First to the star line wins. The badge at the top counts the race.

speaker: narrator
text: Stars come from running Depots, fully paved routes, city tiers, top-level Depots and holds.

speaker: narrator
text: The menu holds difficulty, sound, the camera keys and this tutorial.

speaker: narrator
text: The radio plays while you build. Its own switch lives in the settings sheet.

speaker: narrator
text: The Tutorial menu replays any section, and marks the ones you have finished.

speaker: rival
text: That mill is mine. You studied the map too long.

speaker: rival
text: First depot on the site keeps it. Read your own charter.

speaker: rival
text: Claimed. Complain to the wind, if the wind is hiring.

speaker: rival
text: You took my industry? Bold, for a firm still hiring clerks.

speaker: rival
text: Enjoy the ore. I shall enjoy sending the invoice.

speaker: rival
text: Road's shut. My men are very thorough about standing still.

speaker: rival
text: A blockade, not a suggestion. Your lorries can wait in line.

speaker: rival
text: Forty-five seconds. I have had naps longer than your schedule.

speaker: rival
text: The board is mine. Do try to lose with more dignity.

speaker: rival
text: Match lost. Your gems were decorative. Mine were loaded.

speaker: rival
text: A fluke. The next board will not be so kind.

speaker: rival
text: You won a skirmish. I still own the timetable.

speaker: rival
text: I am ahead on the stars. Do keep up, if you can.

speaker: rival
text: The ledger prefers me today. It usually does.

speaker: rival
text: Pulling ahead. Your factory looks rather lonely from up here.

speaker: rival
text: A lucky season. Do not expect the next one to be.

speaker: rival
text: The stars are mine. Your lorries may go home now.

speaker: player
text: First depot is up. Without a road it is only a shed.

speaker: player
text: Depot placed. The industry answers to us, if the road holds.

speaker: player
text: There she goes. First train on the line, and on time.

speaker: player
text: Whistle's up. The yard finally sounds like a proper railway.

speaker: player
text: The island is ours. File the ledger, and light the lamps.

speaker: player
text: We crossed the line. Tell the rival to mind the gate.

speaker: player
text: They took the prize. The yard still stands. We rebuild.

speaker: player
text: Beaten on the stars. Not on the will to lay more track.

speaker: player
text: Board is ours. Their industry can wait on our timetable.

speaker: player
text: Lost the match. The road is still mine to pave.
